scenario: 面试官说帖子可以包含文字、图片、视频，但为了控制这轮面试的范围，先只处理文字和图片。
q: 这轮 harmful content 系统设计的输入范围是什么？
options: 只处理文本，图片和视频完全忽略
处理所有模态包括视频，范围不能缩小
处理文本和图片，视频先搁置为后续扩展
只处理图片，文本交给关键词过滤
options_en: Only process text; ignore images and video entirely.
Process every modality including video; the scope cannot shrink.
Process text and images; defer video to a future extension.
Only process images; hand text off to keyword filtering.
why: 面试官已经明确把范围收窄到文本+图片，视频留作未来扩展；把这层约束原样带进设计比自行扩大范围更准确。
why_en: The interviewer explicitly scoped this design to text and images, with video deferred, so the system should match that stated boundary.
optionExplanations: 文本仍是一等输入，不能被忽略。
题目已经明确表态先不做视频。
match，这是面试官给定的范围。
文本同样是主信号，不能只靠关键词。
optionExplanations_en: Text is still a first-class input and cannot be dropped.
The interviewer already scoped video out for this round.
This matches the boundary the interviewer stated.
Text is a primary signal too, not just keyword filtering.
q_en: What input modalities are in scope for this harmful-content design?
scenario_en: The interviewer says posts may contain text, images, and video, but this round should only handle text and images to keep scope controlled.

q: 设计 harmful content 系统前，应向面试官确认哪些关键约束？（多选）
options: 帖子涉及哪些模态、政策覆盖哪些违规类型
命中后能做的动作：删除、降权还是送人工审核
误删和漏判各自的代价，以及多大 precision 才能自动删除
每天发帖量和 harmful 内容的大致占比
options_en: Which modalities posts include and which violation types the policy covers.
What actions are available on a hit: removal, demotion, or human review.
The cost of false positives versus false negatives, and what precision unlocks auto-removal.
Daily post volume and roughly how prevalent harmful content is.
why: 这四类问题决定模型阈值、标注策略、serving 方式和评估口径，缺一个都会让设计假设站不住。
why_en: These four clarifying questions fix the modality scope, available actions, error costs, and scale that the rest of the design depends on.
optionExplanations: 决定模型输入形状和政策标签体系。
决定动作系统要支持哪几种响应。
决定自动删除的 precision guardrail 怎么定。
决定推理成本和类别不平衡的严重程度。
optionExplanations_en: It fixes the model's input modalities and policy taxonomy.
It fixes which actions the system must support.
It sets the precision guardrail for automated removal.
It sets inference cost and how severe the class imbalance is.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除的内容里，真正有害的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the fraction of removed content that is actually harmful.

q_en: Which constraints should you clarify before designing a harmful-content system? (Select all that apply.)
scenario: 你要为日发 5 亿帖的平台设计 harmful content 系统，动笔前只有几分钟澄清需求。
scenario_en: You have only a few minutes of clarification before designing harmful-content moderation for a platform with 500M posts a day.

scenario: 面试官说自动删除前，删除的内容里至少 95% 必须真的有害；模型置信度本身不能直接当作这个百分比。
q: 这个 95% precision guardrail 对自动删除路径意味着什么？
options: 只要模型自己给出的置信度分数达标，就可以直接上线自动删除
阈值要用验证集实测校准，别把 confidence 当 precision
precision 这道门槛只卡人工审核队列，跟能不能自动删除完全无关
只要精确率达到 95%，后续就可以不必再持续监控误删率
options_en: Ship auto-removal the moment the model's own confidence score crosses the threshold.
Calibrate the threshold on a validation set instead of trusting raw confidence.
This precision bar only gates the human-review queue, not whether auto-removal can fire.
Once precision reaches 95%, there is no more need to keep monitoring the false-removal rate.
why: confidence 是模型自己给的分数，precision 是拿验证/回放数据测出来的比例，两者必须分开校准。
why_en: Model confidence and empirical precision are different things, so the removal threshold must be calibrated against held-out labeled data, not just trusted confidence scores.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动执行某个动作前必须达到的最低精确率门槛。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A precision guardrail is the minimum precision an automated action must meet before it is allowed to fire.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型对自己预测结果的打分，不等于实测精确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Confidence is the model's own score for a prediction, which is not the same as measured precision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被自动删除的内容里，真正违规或有害的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the share of automatically removed content that is truly violating or harmful.

q_en: What does the 95% precision guardrail imply for auto-removal?
scenario_en: Before auto-removal, at least 95% of removed content must truly be harmful; raw model confidence cannot be treated as that percentage.
optionExplanations: 置信度只是模型自己打的分数，没拿留出数据验证过，直接当上线门槛并不可靠。
对，这道门槛得用带标签的验证集实测校准，不能只信任模型自己给的分数。
guardrail 同样管着自动删除这条路径，不会因为还有人工审核队列就被豁免。
95% 只是校准那一刻测出的结果，线上分布会漂移，误删率仍要持续盯着。
optionExplanations_en: Confidence is only the model's own score, never checked against a labeled sample, so shipping on it alone is unreliable.
Right call — calibrate this threshold on a labeled validation set instead of trusting the model's own score.
This guardrail also governs the auto-removal path — a separate human queue doesn't exempt it.
95% is only a snapshot from calibration time; the online distribution drifts, so the false-removal rate still needs ongoing monitoring.

scenario: 面试官说平台每天大约有 1B 条新帖子，harmful 内容占比不到 1%。
q: 这个日发帖规模对系统设计最直接的影响是什么？
options: 可以对所有帖子跑最贵的模型，不用考虑成本
harmful 内容占比低，绝对数量也可以忽略
可以把审核放到每月批处理一次
推理成本、级联过滤和缓存必须成为核心设计
options_en: Run the most expensive model on every post since cost doesn't matter.
Since the harmful rate is low, the absolute volume can be ignored.
Batch moderation once a month is sufficient.
Inference cost, cascading filters, and caching must be core design pieces.
why: 1B/day 让单帖推理成本被放大到十亿级别，即使 harmful 占比 <1%，绝对数量依然很大，必须靠级联和缓存控制成本。
why_en: At roughly a billion posts a day, per-post inference cost is multiplied at massive scale, so cascading filters and caching become central even though harmful content is under one percent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先用便宜的轻量模型过滤大部分内容，只把可疑的送进昂贵的重模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cascading filter uses a cheap model to screen most content and only escalates suspicious cases to an expensive model.

q_en: What is the main design impact of this daily post volume?
scenario_en: The platform receives roughly 1B new posts per day, and harmful content is under 1% of posts.
optionExplanations: 1B/day 规模下，每条都跑最贵模型会让总推理成本失控，必须靠分级过滤省钱。
占比虽低于 1%，但乘以 1B 基数后绝对数量仍是百万级，不能当作可以忽略。
有害内容会持续曝光扩散，等一个月批处理会让伤害在这期间无限累积。
对，十亿级流量下这三块必须优先投入设计，否则成本或延迟会先撑不住。
optionExplanations_en: At a billion posts a day, running the priciest model on everything blows up total inference cost; tiering is what keeps it affordable.
Under 1% of a billion posts is still millions of items a day — far too many to wave away as negligible.
Harmful content keeps spreading while it's live; waiting a month for batch review lets the damage pile up.
Right — at billion-scale traffic these three have to be core design pieces, or cost and latency both break.

scenario: 你要给 harmful content 系统定义一个业务目标，而不是直接用模型 accuracy。
q: 最终应该选哪个业务目标？
options: 最大化删除的帖子总数量，完全不管这些帖子内容到底是不是真的违反了平台政策规定
最大化分类 accuracy 这个笼统的整体统计指标，完全不去看用户实际受到的伤害本身
在满足误删 precision guardrail 前提下，最小化 harmful 内容的观看量
只盯着减少人工审核队列这一件事的工作量，完全不管用户实际受到的曝光伤害有多大
options_en: Maximize the number of posts removed, regardless of whether they actually violate stated policy.
Maximize the aggregate classification accuracy metric instead of looking at real user harm itself.
Minimize views of harmful content, subject to a precision guardrail.
Only reduce the human-review workload, regardless of how much exposure harm users actually experience.
why: 用户受到的伤害是有害内容被看到的次数，不是模型分数；按 views 加权还能优先拦住可能爆红的内容。
why_en: The real harm is exposure, not model score, so weighting by views prioritizes catching content before it goes viral, subject to a precision guardrail.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务是纯人工队列排序场景，目标可能更偏向人工审核效率和 SLA。
tradeoff: 曝光量最小化 vs 误删率上限
optionExplanations: 会鼓励过度 flag，牺牲正常用户体验。
accuracy 在类别不平衡下会失真。
对齐真实伤害，且有精确率兜底。
忽略了用户实际受到的曝光伤害。
optionExplanations_en: It rewards over-flagging and hurts legitimate users.
Accuracy is distorted under heavy class imbalance.
It aligns with real user harm and keeps a precision floor.
It ignores the exposure harm users actually experience.

termDefinitions.meaning: 业务目标之外附加的硬性约束，防止优化跑偏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guardrail is a hard constraint layered on top of the main objective to keep optimization from going too far.

q_en: Which business objective should this harmful-content system optimize?
scenario_en: You need to define a business objective for a harmful-content system, not just optimize model accuracy.

q: 为什么“删除最多内容”是坏目标？
options: 会让人工审核队伍立刻消失
会鼓励过度 flag，产生大量误删正常内容
会自动满足 precision guardrail
会让 harmful 曝光量降到 0 且没有代价
options_en: It would make the human review team disappear immediately.
It rewards over-flagging and produces heavy false removal of benign content.
It automatically satisfies the precision guardrail.
It would drop harmful exposure to zero at no cost.
why: 分类问题天然有 FP/FN 权衡；只看删除数量的目标会鼓励模型宁可错杀，伤害正常表达。
why_en: Classification always trades off false positives and negatives, so optimizing for raw removal count rewards over-flagging benign content.
optionExplanations: 目标本身不影响人力配置。
删除量目标没有精确率约束。
删得越多，precision 通常越低不是越高。
现实中删除必然伴随误删代价。
optionExplanations_en: This objective does not touch staffing directly.
Raw removal count has no precision constraint attached.
More removals usually push precision down, not up.
Removal always carries some cost of over-flagging in practice.
q_en: Why is “remove as much content as possible” a bad objective?
scenario: 平台把正常帖被误删后的申诉率也写进考核，你正在给审核模型定优化目标。
scenario_en: The platform tracks appeals from wrongly removed normal posts as a KPI, and you are setting the moderation model objective.

q: 为什么用 harmful views 而不只是 harmful posts 数量？
options: 曝光越多伤害越大，能优先抓传播广的内容
views 比 posts 更容易做到 100% 标注
posts 数量在业务上无法统计
views 和用户体验完全无关
options_en: More views mean more harm, so it prioritizes widely-spread content.
Views are easier to label completely than posts.
The business cannot count the number of posts.
Views have nothing to do with user experience.
why: 同一条 harmful 帖子，被看 100 万次比被看 0 次伤害大得多，用曝光量能优先处理正在扩散的内容。
why_en: A harmful post seen a million times causes far more harm than one seen zero times, so weighting by views prioritizes content that is actively spreading.
optionExplanations: 直接对齐真实伤害的大小。
标注成本和曝光量无关，说法夸大。
posts 数量本身是可统计的日志量。
views 正是伤害规模的代理指标。
optionExplanations_en: It directly tracks the real magnitude of harm.
Labeling cost is unrelated to view count; this overstates the benefit.
Post counts are simple loggable numbers, not unknowable.
Views are exactly the proxy for how much harm occurred.
q_en: Why optimize harmful views instead of just harmful post count?
scenario: 同一批 harmful 帖里有的已被看 100 万次、有的还是 0 次，处理能力只够覆盖一部分。
scenario_en: Some harmful posts already have a million views and some have zero, and you can only act on a fraction of them.

q: harmful content 为什么会随时间更容易判断？
options: 帖子发布后内容本身会随时间自动变得更清晰易懂
模型参数会在部署后随时间自动更新到更准确
曝光后用户的举报、隐藏、评论等行为提供了额外信号
图片本身的分辨率会随时间自动提升变清楚
options_en: Post content automatically becomes clearer and easier to read over time.
Model parameters silently improve in accuracy over time after deployment.
User reports, hides, and comments after exposure add extra signal.
Image resolution automatically increases and gets clearer over time.
why: 刚发布时只有内容和作者特征；曝光后用户的负面反应会提供新的行为信号，让判断变容易，这也是要支持 re-trigger 的原因。
why_en: At publish time only content and author features exist, but user reactions after exposure add behavioral signal that makes classification easier over time.
optionExplanations: 内容本身不会随时间改变。
模型不会自动重训，需要显式触发。
这正是行为信号带来的额外证据。
分辨率是固定的，不会随时间提升。
optionExplanations_en: The content itself does not change over time.
Models do not silently retrain; retraining must be triggered.
This is exactly the extra evidence behavioral signals add.
Image resolution is fixed and does not improve over time.
q_en: Why does harmful content become easier to judge over time?
scenario: 帖子刚发布时系统只拿得到图文和作者信息；曝光几小时后举报、隐藏、评论才陆续到达。
scenario_en: At publish time the system only has the text, images, and creator info; reports, hides, and comments only arrive hours after exposure.

q: harmful content 的核心 ML 建模目标是什么？
options: 多分类：判断具体违规类型
回归：预测帖子会被举报几次
排序：给帖子按有害程度排名返回列表
二分类：判断帖子是否 harmful
options_en: Multi-class: identify the specific violation type.
Regression: predict how many reports a post will get.
Ranking: return a list of posts sorted by harm level.
Binary classification: decide whether a post is harmful.
why: 主分类器先输出一个二元 harmful 风险分数，类型细分和排序都是后续的辅助任务，不是核心 ML 目标。
why_en: The core ML task is a binary harmful-or-not classification; type breakdown and ranking are auxiliary, not the primary objective.
optionExplanations: 类型细分是辅助 head，不是核心目标。
举报次数是特征来源，不是主任务。
没有需要返回排序列表的产品需求。
校准层和动作系统都建在这个二分类之上。
optionExplanations_en: Type breakdown is an auxiliary head, not the core objective.
Report counts are a feature source, not the primary task.
There is no product need for a ranked list here.
The calibration and action layers are built on top of this binary task.
q_en: What is the core ML modeling objective for harmful content?
scenario: 动作层只需要一个分数来决定删除、降权还是送审，违规类型细分只用于事后诊断。
scenario_en: The action layer only needs one score to choose removal, demotion, or review; the violation type only matters for diagnostics later.

q: 按正确顺序排列 harmful content 高层流程。
why: 先触发模型评分，再校准到可执行概率，最后按阈值采取不同风险动作。
why_en: The moderation pipeline triggers classification, calibrates the harmfulness score, and then applies removal, demotion, or review actions.
steps: 校准分数以满足 precision guardrail
帖子创建或行为更新触发分类
动作系统删除、降权或送人工审核
多模态分类器输出 harmful 分数
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Trigger[Post or update] --> Model[Multimodal score]
  Model --> Cal[Calibrate]
  Cal --> Action[Remove demote review]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型原始分数调整成可信赖的概率，使其对应实际精确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration adjusts a model's raw score into a trustworthy probability that matches real-world precision.

q_en: Put the high-level harmful-content pipeline in the correct order.

q: 初始 50k 标注集（约 50% harmful / 50% benign）对训练意味着什么？
options: 可以直接把这批数据当成线上真实分布来训练和评估模型，不用再调整
适合初始训练，但评估和阈值仍要按线上 <1% 的真实占比来标定
五万条标注数据规模太小，对起步训练完全没有任何价值可言
只能用来训练图片编码器这一个组件，没法训练完整的分类器
options_en: Treat this whole batch directly as the true online distribution for both training and evaluation work.
Good for initial training, but evaluation and thresholds must still match the true under-1% online rate.
Fifty thousand labeled examples is far too small to have any real training value at all.
Only useful for training the image encoder component, never the full classifier itself.
why: 50/50 的平衡集比线上分布更适合起步训练，但线上 harmful 远低于 1%，评估和阈值必须按真实占比校准，不能直接套用。
why_en: The fifty-fifty balanced set is good for bootstrapping training, but evaluation and thresholds must still be calibrated to the true under-one-percent online prevalence.
optionExplanations: 50/50 平衡集和线上 <1% 分布差很远。
平衡集适合起步，评估仍需按真实占比校准。
5万条标注对起步训练已经足够有用。
标注集覆盖文本和图片，不止图片。
optionExplanations_en: A fifty-fifty set is far from the real under-one-percent online mix.
It is fine for bootstrapping, but evaluation still needs true-prevalence calibration.
Fifty thousand labeled examples are plenty for bootstrapping.
The labels cover text and images, not only images.
q_en: What does the initial 50k balanced labeled set mean for training?
scenario: 标注预算只够 5 万条，团队按 50/50 采样以便起步，但线上 harmful 占比不到 1%。
scenario_en: The labeling budget covers only 50k items sampled 50/50 to bootstrap training, while live harmful prevalence is under 1%.

scenario: 你想用公开 NSFW 数据集增强训练。
q: 使用公开 NSFW 数据集扩充训练集时，必须注意什么？
options: 它缺少平台特有的行为/作者特征，且可能带来分布或政策偏差
它标注的违规定义一定和平台政策完全一致，不用检查
它规模够大，可以完全替代平台自己的线上标注
把它加进训练集不需要做任何额外评估就能直接用
options_en: It lacks platform-specific behavior and author features, and may introduce distribution or policy bias.
Its violation definitions are guaranteed to match the platform's policy exactly, no need to check.
It is large enough to fully replace the platform's own online labeling effort.
Adding it to training requires no extra evaluation before use.
why: 外部数据能扩展覆盖面，但它没有平台特有的行为/作者特征，标签政策也可能和本平台不同，需要验证是否真的帮到目标任务。
why_en: External datasets widen coverage but lack platform-specific signals and may use a different labeling policy, so their benefit must be validated before trusting them.
whenOtherWins: 如果公开数据和平台政策高度一致，且只用于预训练内容 encoder，风险会小很多。
tradeoff: 扩大内容覆盖 vs 引入分布/政策偏差
optionExplanations: 外部标签体系和平台政策未必对齐。
不同平台的违规定义通常不完全一致。
它替代不了平台特有的行为/作者信号。
混入偏差数据必须先验证再上线。
optionExplanations_en: External label taxonomies rarely match the platform's policy exactly.
Violation definitions differ across platforms.
It cannot replace platform-specific behavior and author signals.
Biased external data must be validated before use.

termDefinitions.meaning: Not Safe For Work，指不适合工作场合公开查看的敏感内容标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NSFW stands for not safe for work, a label for sensitive content unsuitable for public or workplace viewing.

q_en: What must you watch out for when adding a public NSFW dataset?
scenario_en: You want to use a public NSFW dataset to expand the training set.

scenario: 有害内容模式随时间变化，初始 50k 标签逐渐过时。
q: 为应对数据漂移，应优先收集什么样的新标签？
options: 永远只用最初那批 50k 数据
持续收集新鲜的 hard case 和边界样本
只标注明显 harmful 的样本
只标注明显 benign 的样本
options_en: Keep using only the original fifty-thousand-example batch forever.
Continuously collect fresh hard and boundary-case examples.
Only label obviously harmful examples.
Only label obviously benign examples.
why: 有害内容的模式会随时间漂移，模型最需要的是容易被误判的新鲜难例，而不是重复简单样本。
why_en: Harmful content patterns drift over time, so the model benefits most from fresh hard and boundary cases, not more easy repeats.
tradeoff: 标注成本 vs 边界质量
optionExplanations: 旧数据无法覆盖新出现的模式。
难例最能改善模型的判断边界。
只标明显样本学不到边界在哪。
同上，缺少边界信息。
optionExplanations_en: Stale data cannot cover newly emerging patterns.
Hard cases teach the model where its decision boundary is weak.
Only-obvious labels teach nothing about the boundary.
Same problem — no boundary information.
q_en: What fresh labels should you collect first to handle data drift?
scenario_en: Harmful-content patterns change over time, so the initial 50k labels are becoming stale.

q: 用户举报在训练中最适合扮演什么角色？
options: 完全等价于人工标注给出的真值标签
可以直接当作模型内部的参数来使用
高量但有噪声的 proxy label，适合辅助任务
和分类任务完全无关，只是前端展示用的事件
options_en: Treat it as exactly equivalent to human-labeled ground truth.
Use it directly as an internal parameter of the model.
A high-volume but noisy proxy label suited for an auxiliary task.
A frontend-only event completely unrelated to the classification task.
why: 举报量远大于人工标签（约千万级 vs 5万级），但可能是误报或对抗，适合当辅助信号而不是主任务真值。
why_en: Reports vastly outnumber human labels but can be mistaken or adversarial, so they work best as an auxiliary weak-supervision signal, not ground truth.
optionExplanations: 举报会被恶意或误解使用，不等于真值。
举报是数据信号，不是模型内部参数。
量大但噪声高，正是 proxy label 的定义。
举报直接和帖子是否有害相关。
optionExplanations_en: Reports can be adversarial or mistaken, so they are not ground truth.
Reports are a data signal, not internal model parameters.
High volume but noisy is exactly the definition of a proxy label.
Reports are directly related to whether a post is harmful.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不是真实标签，但和真实标签相关、可以用来近似监督信号的替代标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A proxy label is not the true label but correlates with it closely enough to serve as an approximate supervision signal.

q_en: What role should user reports play in training?
scenario: 人工标注只有 5 万条，用户举报每天上千万条，但举报里混着误报和有组织的刷量。
scenario_en: You have 50k human labels but tens of millions of user reports a day, and those reports include mistakes and coordinated brigading.

q: 用户评论为什么能给 harmful content 模型做自监督信号？
options: 用帖子预测评论能让模型学到更有用的帖子表示
评论内容永远是准确的 harmful 标签
评论只能用于前端展示，不能进模型
预测评论会替代图片特征提取
options_en: Predicting comments from posts helps the model learn richer post representations.
Comment content is always an accurate harmful label.
Comments can only be shown in the UI, never fed into the model.
Predicting comments would replace image feature extraction.
why: “恶心”这类评论不总是可靠标签，但用帖子预测评论这个自监督任务能让模型学到比单纯预测标签更丰富的语义表示。
why_en: Comments are not always reliable labels, but training a model to predict comments from posts self-supervises richer semantic representations than label prediction alone.
optionExplanations: 这是自监督表示学习的核心价值。
同一句评论可能出现在无害语境里。
评论文本可以作为训练信号进模型。
预测评论是补充信号，不是替代图片特征。
optionExplanations_en: This is the core value of self-supervised representation learning.
The same comment can appear in a harmless context too.
Comment text can be used as a training signal inside the model.
Predicting comments supplements image features, it does not replace them.
q_en: Why can user comments serve as a self-supervision signal for a harmful-content model?
scenario: 人工标注只有 5 万条，但每条帖子天然带着大量用户评论，且完全免费。
scenario_en: Human labels top out at 50k, yet every post naturally carries plenty of user comments that cost nothing to collect.

q: 线上 harmful 占比 <1% 时，直接按原始分布训练的最大风险是什么？
options: precision 会自动变成 100%，不用再管误判
标注数据会因此自动变多，标注成本降低
阈值调优从此会变得完全不再必要
模型学会几乎全判 benign，accuracy 虚高
options_en: Precision automatically becomes 100%, so misclassification no longer matters.
Labeled data automatically increases and labeling cost drops.
Threshold tuning becomes completely unnecessary from then on.
The model learns to predict almost always benign while accuracy looks high.
why: 类别极度不平衡时，全判 benign 也能拿到 99% accuracy，这个假象掩盖了模型其实没学到 harmful 的判别能力。
why_en: With extreme class imbalance, always predicting benign still yields near-99% accuracy, hiding the fact the model never learned to discriminate harmful content.
optionExplanations: 全判 benign 时 precision 反而没有意义。
训练策略不会凭空增加标注数据。
阈值调优在不平衡场景下更关键。
这正是类别不平衡制造的准确率假象。
optionExplanations_en: Precision is meaningless when the model always predicts benign.
A training strategy does not conjure more labeled data.
Threshold tuning becomes more critical under imbalance, not less.
This is exactly the accuracy illusion class imbalance creates.
q_en: What is the biggest risk of training directly on the under-1% online distribution?
scenario: 平台每天 5 亿帖里 harmful 不到 1%，团队想直接按线上原始分布采样训练。
scenario_en: Harmful posts are under 1% of 500M daily posts, and the team wants to train directly on that raw online distribution.

q: harmful content 的一等内容输入包括哪些？（多选）
options: 帖子正文和 hashtags 等文本
附加图片集合
可从图片/文本学到的多模态语义
数据库主键自增值
options_en: Post body text and hashtags.
The collection of attached images.
Multimodal semantics learned jointly from image and text.
The database auto-increment primary key.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Post[Post] --> Text[Text and hashtags]
  Post --> Images[Attached images]
  Text --> Semantic[Multimodal semantics]
  Images --> Semantic
  Semantic --> Classifier[Harm classifier]
why: 政策判断主要依赖内容本身：文本和图片是一等输入，模型再从两者学习跨模态语义；数据库自增 ID 不携带任何语义信号。
why_en: Policy judgments mostly depend on the content itself, so text and images are first-class inputs and the model also learns cross-modal semantics from them, while a database auto-increment ID carries no semantic signal.
optionExplanations: 文本承载政策相关的直接语义信号。
图片同样是判断违规的一等信号。
跨模态语义补足单一模态漏掉的组合违规。
自增主键只是存储标识，无语义信息。
optionExplanations_en: Text carries direct semantic signal relevant to policy.
Images are equally a first-class signal for violations.
Cross-modal semantics catch combined violations either modality misses alone.
An auto-increment key is just a storage id with no semantics.
q_en: Which first-class content inputs belong in a harmful-content model? (Select all that apply.)
scenario: 政策判定看的是这条帖子发布了什么内容，而不是谁在什么时候把它写进了哪张表。
scenario_en: Policy decisions rest on what a post actually contains, not on who wrote it or which table row it landed in.

q: 为什么这是多模态分类问题？
options: 只需要读取用户 ID 就能判断
标签可能取决于文本、图片，以及二者的组合
只需要一张数值表格就能判断
模型只需要输出一个排序列表
options_en: Only the user ID needs to be read to decide.
The label can depend on text, images, or their combination.
Only one numeric feature table is needed to decide.
The model only needs to output a ranked list.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Text[Text meaning] --> Fuse[Joint reasoning]
  Image[Image meaning] --> Fuse
  Fuse --> Harm[Harm label]
  Text -. alone may miss .-> Harm
  Image -. alone may miss .-> Harm
why: 单看图片可能无害，配上特定文字才违规，反之亦然；模型必须能学习跨模态交互，而不只是各模态独立判断。
why_en: An image can be benign alone but harmful paired with certain text, and vice versa, so the model must learn cross-modal interaction rather than judging each modality separately.
optionExplanations: 用户 ID 只是作者先验，不含内容语义。
这正是多模态问题的定义。
数值表格丢失了文本和图片本身的语义。
任务是二分类，不是排序输出。
optionExplanations_en: A user ID is only an author prior with no content semantics.
This is exactly the definition of a multimodal problem.
A numeric table loses the actual text and image semantics.
The task is binary classification, not producing a ranked list.
q_en: Why is this a multimodal classification problem?
scenario: 同一张图配减肥食谱是无害的，配上煽动仇恨的文案就要删，反过来也一样。
scenario_en: The same image is harmless next to a diet recipe but removable next to hateful text, and the reverse happens too.

scenario: 帖子刚发时内容模型分数低，但快速收到大量 hides 和负面评论。
q: 系统应该如何利用这类快速变化的行为信号？
options: 把行为特征当 fast-moving signals，并在关键事件后 re-trigger 分类
忽略发布后出现的所有行为反应和用户信号，只信任发布那一刻的初始内容分数，之后永远不再更新
不管初始内容分数当时有多低，都统一排队等人工审核团队一个月后再处理
只反复用最初上传的那张原始图片重新打分，完全不看任何行为方面的新证据
options_en: Treat behavior as fast-moving signals and retrigger classification on key events.
Ignore every bit of post-publish behavior and trust only the frozen initial content score forever.
Queue everything uniformly for a full month of human review regardless of the initial score.
Keep rescoring only the original uploaded image forever, ignoring any behavioral evidence.
why: 行为反馈能补足内容模型的盲点，尤其是曝光后才显现的用户反应，因此需要在关键事件后重新触发分类。
why_en: Behavioral feedback fills gaps that content alone misses, especially reactions that only appear after exposure, so classification should retrigger on important behavioral events.
whenOtherWins: 如果帖子几乎没有曝光，缺少行为信号时仍要主要依赖内容和作者特征判断。
tradeoff: 更快发现晚熟违规 vs re-trigger 带来的额外计算和训练对齐成本
optionExplanations: 这正是行为信号存在的意义。
忽略行为会漏掉曝光后才显现的违规。
人工队列容量有限，不能作为主路径。
只看原图会漏掉行为透露的新证据。
optionExplanations_en: This is exactly what behavioral signals are for.
Ignoring behavior misses violations that only surface after exposure.
Human review capacity is limited and cannot be the primary path.
Only looking at the original image misses evidence behavior reveals.
q_en: How should the system use these fast-changing behavioral signals?
scenario_en: A post has a low content-model score at publish time, but quickly receives many hides and negative comments.

q: negative_reactions_per_view 这类比例，为什么在低曝光时需要平滑？
options: 曝光少时这个比例根本没法算出任何数值
平滑处理会把所有原始信号都直接删掉
曝光少时比例会因为分母小而极不稳定，容易误判
views 在这个特征公式里完全不重要
options_en: The ratio simply cannot be computed at all when there are so few views logged.
Smoothing would erase every bit of the original signal, leaving nothing useful.
With few views the ratio is unstable because the denominator is small.
Views do not matter at all in this feature's underlying formula design.
why: 一个帖子刚发布时分母（views）很小，一两次负反馈就能把比例推到极端；Bayesian averaging 用先验把小分母拉回合理范围。
why_en: When a post has very few views, one or two negative reactions can swing the ratio to an extreme, so Bayesian averaging pulls low-denominator ratios back toward a sane prior.
optionExplanations: 分子分母都在，是能算的，只是不稳定。
平滑是压低极端值，不是清空信号。
小分母下少量事件就能左右比例。
views 正是这个比例的分母来源。
optionExplanations_en: Numerator and denominator both exist; it is unstable, not incomputable.
Smoothing tempers extreme values, it does not erase the signal.
With a tiny denominator, a few events can swing the ratio wildly.
Views are exactly the denominator this ratio is built on.
q_en: Why should ratios like negative reactions per view be smoothed at low exposure?

termDefinitions.meaning: 用先验值和真实观测混合，避免小分母比例被一两个事件推到极端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian averaging blends a prior with observed data so a tiny denominator cannot swing a rate to an extreme.

scenario: 刚发布 10 分钟的帖子只有 20 次曝光，其中 2 次负反馈就算出 10% 的负反馈率。
scenario_en: A ten-minute-old post has only 20 views, so two negative reactions already put its negative rate at 10%.

scenario: 你要为 harmful content 构造稳定的负反馈率特征。
q: 这段平滑公式的设计目的是什么？
options: 训练一个 ViT 图像编码器
用先验把小分母的行为比例拉向稳定值
对模型输出分数做后校准
给线上流量做 A/B 分流
options_en: Train a ViT image encoder.
Pull low-denominator behavioral ratios toward a stable prior.
Post-calibrate the model's output score.
Split online traffic for an A/B test.
why: 分子加先验、分母加常数 C，让曝光少的帖子比例被拉向全局先验，曝光变多后数据自然主导。
why_en: Adding a prior to the numerator and a constant C to the denominator pulls low-view ratios toward a global prior, letting real data dominate once views accumulate.
whenOtherWins: 当帖子已经积累大量曝光时，加不加平滑结果都很接近，直接用原始比例也可以。
tradeoff: 小样本稳定性 vs 曝光量增多后数据主导的灵敏度
optionExplanations: 公式和图像编码结构完全无关。
prior_rate 和常数 C 正是这个作用。
这是特征工程，不是分数校准层。
公式里没有流量分桶逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: The formula has nothing to do with an image encoder.
The prior_rate and constant C do exactly this.
This is feature engineering, not a score-calibration layer.
There is no traffic-bucketing logic in the formula.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个先验信念把小样本估计拉向更合理的值，避免极端分母失真。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian averaging blends a small-sample estimate with a prior belief so a tiny denominator cannot distort the result.

q_en: What is this smoothing formula designed to do?
scenario_en: You need a stable negative-feedback-rate feature for harmful-content ranking.

q: 作者特征为什么有用？
options: 部分账号的历史和信誉能提供发布 harmful 内容的先验
作者特征不管在什么场景下都永远比内容特征更重要
有了作者特征以后，就可以把内容特征彻底丢弃不看
作者特征天生就不需要按活跃度做任何归一化处理
options_en: Some accounts' history and reputation give a prior on posting harmful content.
Creator features always outweigh content features no matter the situation or scale.
Once you have creator features, content features can be dropped and ignored entirely.
Creator features never need normalizing by activity level under any circumstance.
why: 长期行为、社群、举报历史和账号异常都能提供先验，但它是内容判断的补充，不能替代内容本身。
why_en: Long-term behavior, community, report history, and account anomalies provide a useful prior, but they supplement content judgment rather than replace it.
optionExplanations: 历史信誉正是先验的来源。
内容特征仍是最直接的判断信号。
丢弃内容特征会漏掉大多数违规证据。
不归一化会让活跃用户的统计量失真。
optionExplanations_en: History and reputation are exactly where the prior comes from.
Content features remain the most direct evidence.
Dropping content features would miss most violation evidence.
Without normalization, active users' stats get distorted.
q_en: Why are creator features useful?
scenario: 某账号一年内被反复举报，但眼下这条帖的图文单看并不明显违规。
scenario_en: An account has been reported repeatedly all year, yet the text and image of this particular post look borderline at worst.

scenario: 你要向面试官解释作者 embedding 和实时行为特征这两类信号为什么要一起用。
q: 作者 embedding 与实时行为特征在互补关系上，核心区别维度是什么？
options: 两者完全等价，训练好其中一个就能互相替代另一个
embedding 只能表达单次孤立事件，完全无法沉淀长期历史
实时特征只能靠离线批量更新，永远做不到近实时
embedding 表达慢而丰富的历史画像，实时特征表达快而噪的近期变化
options_en: The two signals are fully equivalent, so training one makes the other completely redundant forever.
An embedding can only express a single isolated event and never accumulated history at all.
Real-time features can only ever be updated in offline batches, never near-real-time.
Embeddings hold a slow, rich history; real-time features carry fast, noisy signals about right now.
why: embedding 是长期平均画像，捕捉不到突变；举报数、登录国家等实时 tally 更新快但噪声也更大，两者互补才完整。
why_en: Embeddings capture rich long-term profiles but miss sudden shifts, while real-time tallies like reports or login countries update fast but are noisier, so combining both gives a fuller picture.
tradeoff: 历史画像的丰富度 vs 近期突变的响应速度
optionExplanations: 二者速度和噪声特性完全不同。
embedding 聚合的是长期平均行为。
实时 tally 的意义正是能快速更新。
这正是二者互补关系的核心。
optionExplanations_en: The two differ sharply in update speed and noise.
An embedding aggregates long-term average behavior.
The whole point of real-time tallies is fast updates.
This is exactly the core of their complementary relationship.

termDefinitions.term: contextual features / 实时上下文特征
termDefinitions.meaning: 围绕当前时刻统计的快速变化信号，如近期登录国家数、举报数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contextual features are fast-changing signals tallied around the current moment, such as recent login-country count or report count.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户或内容表示成一个稠密数值向量，方便模型计算和比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding represents a user or piece of content as a dense numeric vector that a model can compute and compare with.

q_en: What core dimension separates creator embeddings from real-time behavior features?
scenario_en: You need to explain why creator embeddings and real-time behavior features should be used together.

scenario: 老账号历史 embedding 很正常，但突然从多个国家登录并发布异常内容。
q: 哪些特征能补住 embedding 的盲点，及时发现账号异常？
options: 只用长期 embedding 这一个信号就够了，完全不用别的
只看账号注册年龄这一个静态属性，别的都不用管
实时账号上下文，如登录国家数、近期举报量、发帖突增
完全不看任何行为信号，只靠内容本身来判断是否异常
options_en: Rely on the long-term embedding alone and nothing else, no matter what changed.
Only look at the one static signal of account registration age and ignore all the rest.
Real-time account context, such as login-country count, recent reports, and posting bursts.
Ignore behavioral signals entirely and judge the account only by its content.
why: 长期 embedding 滞后于账号被盗这类突变，实时 tally（登录国家、举报量、发帖频率）能快速暴露异常状态。
why_en: Long-term embeddings lag behind sudden shifts like account compromise, so real-time tallies of login countries, reports, and posting bursts expose the anomaly quickly.
whenOtherWins: 如果没有近期异常且内容本身清晰违规，长期 embedding 加内容模型仍是主信号。
tradeoff: 捕捉突发异常的灵敏度 vs 实时特征的噪声
optionExplanations: embedding 更新慢，跟不上突变。
账号年龄不反映近期是否被盗。
这些实时信号正好捕捉突发异常。
完全不看行为会错过所有突变线索。
optionExplanations_en: Embeddings update slowly and lag behind sudden change.
Account age says nothing about a recent compromise.
These real-time signals are exactly what catches a sudden anomaly.
Ignoring behavior entirely misses every compromise clue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户历史行为压缩成的一个稠密向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a dense vector representation that compresses a user's historical behavior.

q_en: Which features fill the blind spot of embeddings and catch account anomalies quickly?
scenario_en: An older account has a normal historical embedding, but suddenly logs in from multiple countries and posts unusual content.

scenario: 你要给 harmful content 建一个简单 baseline。
q: 给 harmful content 建一个简单基线模型，合理选择是？
options: 直接上全量多模态 Transformer，把它当作第一版基线模型
对数值和 embedding 特征跑 Logistic Regression
只按帖子 ID 是奇数还是偶数来分类，别的都不看
把所有内容都送人工审核，完全不训练任何模型
options_en: Ship a full multimodal Transformer straight away as the very first baseline.
Run logistic regression over numeric and embedding features.
Classify purely by whether the post ID happens to be odd or even, nothing else.
Send everything to human review and skip training a model entirely.
why: Logistic regression 快、可解释、容易更新，能当复杂模型的地板线，虽然它学不到特征间的隐式依赖。
why_en: Logistic regression is fast, explainable, and easy to update, making it a solid floor baseline, even though it cannot implicitly model dependencies between features.
whenOtherWins: 如果内容模态是主要信号且已有预训练 encoder，late fusion 或多模态模型会比这个基线强得多。
tradeoff: 训练/上线速度 vs 无法建模跨特征依赖
optionExplanations: 作为第一版直接上重模型会拖慢迭代。
地板线要求便宜、可解释、能快速上线。
帖子 ID 奇偶和是否 harmful 无关。
全人工在 1B/day 规模下不可行。
optionExplanations_en: Shipping the heavy model first slows down iteration.
A floor baseline needs to be cheap, explainable, and quick to ship.
Post ID parity has nothing to do with harm.
All-human review is infeasible at a billion posts a day.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用向量表示的用户或内容特征，可以直接喂进简单模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding features are vector-represented user or content signals that can be fed directly into a simple model.

q_en: What is a reasonable simple baseline for harmful-content modeling?
scenario_en: You need to build a simple baseline for harmful-content detection.

q: 单独训练文本模型和图片模型、再用 max-pooling 合并的主要缺点是什么？
options: 捕捉不到文本和图片之间的细粒度交互
完全不能复用任何预训练模型
推理成本一定比统一模型更贵
无法输出一个连续的风险分数
options_en: It cannot capture fine-grained interaction between text and image.
It cannot reuse any pretrained model at all.
Inference is guaranteed to be more expensive than a unified model.
It cannot output a continuous risk score.
why: 图片单看可能无害，配上特定文字才违规；两个独立模型各判各的、最后才合并，会错过这种跨模态组合信号。
why_en: An image alone can look benign but become harmful once paired with specific text, and two independent models that only combine at the end miss that cross-modal combination.
optionExplanations: 这是最后才合并预测导致的核心损失。
两个独立模型都能直接复用预训练权重。
两个轻模型往往比一个大模型更便宜。
max-pooling 后仍可以输出连续分数。
optionExplanations_en: This is the core loss caused by only combining at the very end.
Both separate models can directly reuse pretrained weights.
Two lighter models are often cheaper than one large model.
Max-pooling can still output a continuous score.
q_en: What is the main weakness of training separate text and image models and max-pooling their scores?
scenario: 团队手上已有现成的文本模型和图片模型，想直接取两个分数的 max 上线省训练成本。
scenario_en: The team already has a text model and an image model and wants to ship the max of the two scores to save training cost.

Late fusion：分别编码后拼接行为/用户特征，进 MLP

options_en: Only use keyword-based rules to filter, with no statistical model trained at all.
Late fusion: encode separately, concatenate behavior and user features, then an MLP.
Throw away every pretrained weight and train the whole multimodal model from scratch.
Only look at the author's account age and ignore the post content entirely.

whenOtherWins: 如果细微的跨模态违规模式是核心难点，统一的多模态 Transformer 更可能赢。
tradeoff: 复用预训练 encoder 的可维护性 vs 跨模态交互只发生在最后一层

复用 encoder 又能接入表格特征。
从零训练成本和风险都太高。
作者年龄丢掉了内容本身的证据。
optionExplanations_en: Keyword rules cannot learn semantic combinations.
It reuses pretrained encoders while still ingesting tabular features.
Training from scratch is too costly and risky here.
Author age throws away the content evidence itself.

Use only a GBDT tree model to process the raw image and text inputs.
A multimodal Transformer where modalities interact through attention.
Rely only on user report counts, with no content model at all.

whenOtherWins: 如果延迟/成本极端紧张，轻量 late fusion 或级联前置模型会更适合。
tradeoff: 跨模态注意力带来的检测质量 vs 计算成本和复杂度

举报计数只是弱监督信号，不是主模型。
optionExplanations_en: A text-only model throws away all image evidence.
GBDT is not built to process raw image and text sequences.
Attention is exactly the mechanism for cross-modal interaction.
Report counts are only a weak-supervision signal, not a primary model.

q: Lightweight Update Network 的作用是什么？
options: 每次帖子行为一变化，就重新编码所有图片、重跑一遍完整 ViT 主模型
在行为特征更新时，把新表格信号和缓存的内容 embedding 快速合并
取代主模型的整个训练过程，成为流水线里唯一的训练环节

Merge fresh tabular signals with the cached content embedding when behavior updates.
Replace the main model's entire training process and become the pipeline's only training step.

optionExplanations: 重编码所有图片正是要避免的开销。
这正是 update network 存在的目的。
它是 serving 时的轻量合并，不是训练流程。
它处理的是特征合并，不是日志。
optionExplanations_en: Re-encoding every image is exactly the cost this avoids.
This is precisely the purpose of the update network.
It is a lightweight serving-time merge, not a training process.
It merges features, not log files.

scenario_en: The text and images of a post never change after publish, but new reports and hides keep arriving every few minutes.

q: 多个 classification heads 的价值是什么？
options: 支持主任务和辅助任务共享表示，并提供诊断信息
让模型的梯度冲突到完全无法收敛训练
彻底替代所有人工标注的标签数据
只是给前端展示用的一个 UI 装饰字段

It makes gradients conflict so badly the model cannot converge at all.
It completely replaces every human-annotated label.
It is merely a UI decoration field for the frontend to display.

why_en: Multiple heads let the model predict harmful and report-related targets from a shared representation, which improves learning and adds diagnostics, though only the primary head drives production actions.
optionExplanations: 共享表示和多任务诊断正是它的价值。
多头训练不会让模型无法收敛。
辅助头依赖标签，不能替代标签本身。
分类头输出的是模型分数，不是 UI。
optionExplanations_en: Shared representations and multi-task diagnostics are exactly its value.
Multi-head training does not prevent the model from converging.
Auxiliary heads still depend on labels; they cannot replace labels.
Classification heads output model scores, not UI elements.
q_en: What value do multiple classification heads add?
scenario: harmful 人工标签只有 5 万条，但举报率、负反馈率这类相关目标的数据量大几个数量级。
scenario_en: There are only 50k harmful labels, while related targets like report rate and negative-reaction rate have orders of magnitude more data.

q: 为什么不能简单用原始 views 直接作为 loss 权重？
options: views 在业务上没有意义
views 根本无法被记录
views 幂律分布，少数爆款内容会支配梯度
所有帖子的 views 都相同

Views cannot be logged at all.
Views are power-law distributed, so a handful of viral posts dominate the gradient.
Every post has the same number of views.
why: 少数内容的 views 可能上亿、大多数是 0，如果直接用原始 views 加权，梯度会被这些极端样本主导，训练变得不稳定。
why_en: A handful of posts can get hundreds of millions of views while most get none, so weighting by raw views lets those extreme samples dominate the gradient and destabilize training.
optionExplanations: views 正是业务目标要优化的量。
views 是可以直接从日志记录的。
幂律分布正是不稳定的根源。
views 差异巨大，远非相同。
optionExplanations_en: Views are exactly what the business objective optimizes.
Views can be logged directly from the system.
The power-law distribution is exactly the source of instability.
Views vary enormously, far from being equal.

codeSample:
view_weight = min(log(1 + views), c)
L_primary = BCE(y_true, y_pred) * view_weight

tradeoff: 让高曝光样本更重要 vs 避免单个爆款样本支配训练
optionExplanations: 代码里没有正负样本对比结构。
Platt scaling 是校准分数，不是加权 loss。
代码和异常检测算法结构不同。
log 加 cap 正是这段代码的两个操作。
optionExplanations_en: There is no positive/negative pair contrastive structure here.
Platt scaling calibrates scores, it does not weight a loss.
The code does not match an anomaly-detection algorithm.
The log term and the cap are exactly the two operations in this code.

q: view-weighted loss 有什么反馈循环风险？
options: 生产环境的 views 会自动变得完全无偏，不用特别处理
模型提前删除内容，会让训练数据缺少这些帖子本应获得的 views
删除的帖子越多，剩下标签的质量就自动变得越好
这种反馈循环下完全不需要任何 holdout 集
options_en: Production views automatically become fully unbiased with no special handling.
Early removal means training data lacks the views those posts would have earned.
The more posts get removed, the better the remaining labels automatically get.
No holdout set is ever needed under this feedback loop.

optionExplanations: 系统自身动作正是偏差的来源。
这正是反馈循环偏差的机制。
删得多只会让偏差更严重。

This is exactly the mechanism of the feedback-loop bias.
Removing more content only makes the bias worse.
Without a holdout there is no way to correct this bias.

scenario: 生产模型在高置信时几秒内就删帖，而训练又用每条帖子的实际 views 给样本加权。
scenario_en: The production model removes high-confidence posts within seconds, and training weights each sample by the views it actually got.

This throws away a large-scale weak-supervision source.

Softmax cannot mathematically be used for classification.

q: 在 1B posts/day、主模型是重多模态 Transformer 的前提下，serving 应该怎么降本？
options: 每条帖子都完整跑一遍最贵的重模型，且完全不做任何缓存
把所有审核都改成每月批处理一次，放弃实时响应
量化 + encoder 缓存 + 轻量蒸馏模型做两阶段过滤
放弃自动化，把所有内容都送进人工审核队列
options_en: Run the full expensive model on every post with absolutely no caching.
Switch all moderation to a once-a-month batch job, giving up real-time response.
Combine quantization, encoder caching, and a distilled two-stage filter.
Give up automation entirely and route everything to human review.

why_en: At this scale, a distilled light model filters obviously safe content first, encoder outputs get cached for repeats, and quantization shrinks the heavy model's compute, and combining all three is what makes billion-scale serving affordable.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有小流量的高风险队列，直接用重模型加人工审核也可能可行。
tradeoff: 组合优化换来的吞吐 vs 引入的额外工程复杂度

全人工在这个规模下完全不现实。
optionExplanations_en: Running the heavy model on everything with no cache is infeasible at this scale.
Monthly batching cannot support timely intervention.
The three techniques together cover different sources of cost.
All-human review is completely unrealistic at this scale.

Let everything through unconditionally.
why: 不同置信度和风险对应不同动作：高置信删除、中等降权、不确定送审；直接全放行放弃了动作层的存在意义。
why_en: Different confidence and risk levels map to different actions — remove, demote, or route to review — while letting everything through defeats the purpose of an action layer.
optionExplanations: 对应高置信度的强动作。
对应中等置信度的软动作。
对应不确定但需要人判断的情况。
放弃了动作层校准的意义。
optionExplanations_en: This maps to the strong action for high confidence.
This maps to the soft action for medium confidence.
This covers uncertain cases needing human judgment.
This abandons the whole point of a calibrated action layer.
q_en: Which actions can the harmful-content action layer take? (Select all that apply.)
scenario: 模型输出的风险分从 0.99 到 0.5 连续分布，人工审核队列每天只吃得下几万条。
scenario_en: Risk scores spread continuously from 0.99 down to 0.5, and the human review queue can absorb only tens of thousands a day.

q: 为什么 harmful views 目标会增加评估难度？
options: 需要持续标注抽样内容或曝光，才能估计有害曝光量
views 完全无法被日志记录
评估阶段不再需要任何人工
precision guardrail 从此不再重要
options_en: It requires ongoing labeling of sampled content or impressions to estimate harmful views.
Views cannot be logged at all.
Evaluation no longer needs any human labeling.
The precision guardrail stops mattering.
why: 要知道多少曝光是 harmful，必须持续抽样标注内容或曝光数据，这个标注成本推动了 proxy metric 和 importance sampling 的使用。
why_en: Knowing how many views were harmful requires ongoing sampled labeling of content or impressions, and that labeling cost is exactly why proxy metrics and importance sampling get used.
optionExplanations: 持续标注正是曝光估计所需要的成本。
views 本身是可以直接记日志的。
标注曝光量恰恰需要持续人工参与。
guardrail 依然是自动删除的硬约束。
optionExplanations_en: Ongoing labeling is exactly the cost needed to estimate exposure.
Views themselves can be logged directly.
Estimating harmful views needs continued human labeling.
The guardrail is still a hard constraint on auto-removal.
q_en: Why does optimizing harmful views make evaluation harder?
scenario: 主目标从 harmful posts 改成 harmful views 后，你要报出线上到底有多少有害曝光。
scenario_en: After switching the north-star metric from harmful posts to harmful views, you must report how much harmful exposure actually happened.

scenario: 用户报告既可能是真实有害，也可能是观点不合的恶意举报。
q: 训练和评估中应如何对待用户报告这个信号？
options: 当作和人工标注完全等价的真值
作为噪声代理信号，结合人工标签做校准和去偏
完全丢弃所有报告数据
直接用报告率替代 precision 指标
options_en: Treat it as exactly equivalent to human-labeled ground truth.
Use it as a noisy proxy signal, calibrated and debiased against human labels.
Discard all report data entirely.
Use report rate directly in place of the precision metric.
why: 报告有规模价值，但可能是恶意举报或用户误解政策产生的噪声，合理做法是当辅助信号，用高质量标签做校准和去偏。
why_en: Reports offer scale but can be noisy from adversarial or mistaken reporters, so the right approach is to treat them as an auxiliary signal calibrated and debiased against trusted labels.
whenOtherWins: 如果某类报告来自高可信的专业审核队列，可以适当提高它的权重。
tradeoff: 利用报告的规模优势 vs 报告本身的噪声和对抗性
optionExplanations: 报告可能是恶意或误解政策产生的。
校准去偏正是处理噪声代理信号的方法。
丢弃会浪费一个规模很大的信号来源。
报告率本身有偏，不能直接顶替 precision。
optionExplanations_en: Reports can be adversarial or based on a misunderstanding of policy.
Calibrating and debiasing is exactly how to handle a noisy proxy signal.
Discarding it wastes a large-scale signal source.
Report rate is itself biased and cannot directly stand in for precision.
q_en: How should training and evaluation treat user reports?
scenario_en: User reports may indicate real harm, but they may also be malicious reports from people who simply disagree.

q: staff-level harmful content 答案通常应更关注什么？
options: 把大部分面试时间都花在只列出最基础的几个特征上
从头到尾只报告一个笼统的 accuracy 数字，别的都不提
标注瓶颈、复杂的多模态取舍、反馈循环，并主动提出 deep dive
刻意避免讨论任何和成本相关的问题，绕着走
options_en: Spend most of the interview time only listing the most basic obvious features.
Report nothing but a single vague accuracy number and never elaborate any further.
Labeling bottlenecks, complex multimodal tradeoffs, feedback loops, and proactive deep dives.
Deliberately steer the conversation around and avoid any cost-related questions entirely.
why: 资深候选人会快速带过基础部分，把时间花在最影响系统成败的数据标注瓶颈、模型取舍和反馈循环上，并主动引导深入讨论。
why_en: Senior candidates move quickly through the basics and spend their time on the labeling bottleneck, hard modeling tradeoffs, and feedback loops that most affect the system's success, proactively steering deep dives.
optionExplanations: 只讲基础显示不出资深候选人的深度。
单一 accuracy 数字掩盖了权衡细节。
这正是资深候选人被期待展示的深度。
回避成本讨论会显得考虑不周全。
optionExplanations_en: Sticking to basics does not show senior-level depth.
A single accuracy number hides the real tradeoffs.
This is exactly the depth senior candidates are expected to show.
Avoiding cost discussion looks like incomplete reasoning.
q_en: What should a staff-level harmful-content answer focus on?
scenario: 45 分钟的 staff 级 ML 系统设计面，列特征和画框图最多值前 10 分钟。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute staff-level ML system design round, listing features and sketching boxes is worth ten minutes at most.

scenario: 审核团队只有几个人、政策定义每季度都在改，你要一个能每天量到的业务目标。
scenario_en: Your moderation team is tiny and the policy definition changes every quarter, yet you need a business objective you can measure daily.
q: 「最小化用户举报量」这个业务目标最大的实操优势是什么？
q_en: What is the biggest practical advantage of the objective "minimize user reports"?
options: 它给出的就是每条内容真实的 harmful 标签，可以当训练监督信号
它是 label-free 的，不用专职审核团队标注就能持续度量
它完全排除了恶意举报，指标噪声比人工标注更低
它把 precision 和 recall 从目标里移除，因此自动删除路径不再需要任何置信阈值
options_en: It hands you the true harmful label for each post, usable as training supervision.
It is label-free: you can keep measuring it without a dedicated moderation team.
It fully rules out adversarial reports, so it is less noisy than human labeling.
It drops precision and recall from the objective, so the auto-delete path no longer needs any confidence threshold.
why: 举报量由用户自己产生，不需要专职标注团队就能天天量到，政策变了用户反应也跟着变；代价是举报有噪声，恶意举报和不懂政策的误报都会混进来。
why_en: Report volume comes from users, so you measure it daily with no labeling team and it adapts as policy changes; the cost is noisy reports, adversarial or simply mistaken.
optionExplanations: 举报只是相关的代理标签，不等于真实的 harmful 判定。
度量成本近乎为零，还能跟着政策定义一起漂移。
恰恰相反，立场对立的用户会举报无害内容。
guardrail 依然要设，换目标不等于阈值消失。
optionExplanations_en: Reports are only a correlated proxy label, not the true harmful verdict.
Measuring costs almost nothing and drifts along with the policy definition.
The opposite: users who disagree with content report benign posts.
The guardrail still applies; changing the objective does not remove thresholds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 指标不依赖人工标注就能算出来，因此度量成本几乎为零。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A label-free metric can be computed without human annotation, so measuring it costs almost nothing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被判为有害的内容中，真正有害的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the share of content flagged as harmful that really is harmful.

termDefinitions.meaning: 所有真实有害内容中，被系统抓到的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the share of all truly harmful content that the system catches.

termDefinitions.meaning: 目标之外附加的硬约束，比如自动删除必须 95% precision 以上。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guardrail is a hard constraint layered on the objective, such as requiring 95% precision before auto-deleting.

scenario: harmful 只占线上帖子的不到 1%，按原始分布训练模型会全预测 benign 还拿到 99% accuracy。
scenario_en: Harmful posts are under 1% of traffic, so training on the raw distribution yields a model that predicts benign for everything and still scores 99% accuracy.
q: 训练时该怎么同时处理类别不平衡和 precision-recall 权衡？
q_en: How should training handle class imbalance and the precision-recall tradeoff at the same time?
options: 只做 balanced sampling 取一半正例，权衡全部交给推理阶段的阈值
balanced sampling 让模型看够正例，loss weighting 再微调权衡位置
保留原始比例的 benign 样本，只靠加大模型容量来学会稀有类
继续用不到 1% 的原始分布训练，之后在评估阶段改用 accuracy 当主指标，让不平衡的影响看起来消失
options_en: Only do balanced sampling to a fifty-fifty split and leave the tradeoff entirely to the serving threshold.
Balanced sampling gets enough positives in front of the model; loss weighting then tunes the tradeoff.
Keep benign samples at their raw share and rely on a bigger model to learn the rare class.
Keep training on the raw sub-one-percent distribution and then switch the headline metric to accuracy at evaluation time so the imbalance appears to go away.
why: balanced sampling 解决「正例太少模型看不到」，loss weighting 解决「要偏 precision 还是 recall」；代价是采样后输出概率被扭曲，必须再过校准层。
why_en: Balanced sampling fixes "the model never sees positives"; loss weighting then dials where you sit on precision versus recall. The cost is distorted output probabilities a calibration layer must correct.
tradeoff: 看见稀有正例 vs 输出概率被扭曲
whenOtherWins: 如果标注正例本来就充足、线上分布也接近平衡，直接按原始分布训练更省事，还免掉为采样偏移做概率校准这一步。
optionExplanations: 采样解决了看得见，但没给出偏向哪一侧的旋钮。
两个手段各管一件事，合起来才完整。
容量再大也压不住 99 比 1 的多数类梯度。
accuracy 在这个比例下毫无区分力，是在掩盖问题。
optionExplanations_en: Sampling makes positives visible but gives no knob for which side to lean toward.
Each technique owns one job; together they cover both.
More capacity still cannot outweigh gradients from a ninety-nine to one majority class.
Accuracy has no discriminative power at this ratio; it hides the problem.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时按类别重新取样，让稀有的正例在每个 batch 里占到可观比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Balanced sampling resamples by class so the rare positive class makes up a meaningful share of every batch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给不同类别的样本在损失里赋不同权重，用来拨动 precision 和 recall 的相对位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Loss weighting assigns different weights per class in the loss, shifting where the model sits between precision and recall.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测正确的样本占全部样本的比例，在极度不平衡时会失去区分力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Accuracy is the fraction of correct predictions, which becomes meaningless under extreme class imbalance.

scenario: 一条帖子发布时打一次分，之后每次被举报、曝光激增又被重新打分，热门帖一天可能被打十几次。
scenario_en: A post is scored once at creation and re-scored on every report or view spike, so a hot post can be scored a dozen times a day.
q: 重复重触发打分会给保证 95% precision 的校准层带来什么问题？
q_en: What problem does repeated re-triggering create for the calibration layer that guarantees 95% precision?
options: 重触发只会让分数逐渐变准，校准层完全不受影响
同一条内容被重复计入分数分布，校准阈值被算偏
校准层会因为重触发而彻底失效，必须每次重训整个主模型才能恢复
重触发时文本和图片编码器都会重算，校准层的输入分布每次都不一样
options_en: Re-triggering only sharpens the score over time and leaves calibration untouched.
The same post enters the score distribution repeatedly, skewing the calibrated threshold.
Calibration breaks down completely under re-triggering and the whole main model must be retrained each time.
Re-triggering recomputes the text and image encoders, so the calibration layer sees a different input distribution each time.
why: 一条内容多次进入分数分布，高活跃内容被超额计权，阈值偏移后自动删除的真实 precision 会掉到 95% 以下；修法是按内容去重、只用最新分数校准。
why_en: One post lands in the score distribution many times, so the threshold drifts and real auto-delete precision drops below 95%; dedupe by content and calibrate on the latest score only.
optionExplanations: 分数会变准，但分布被污染是另一回事。
按打分次数估分位，等于给活跃内容投多票。
校准是薄薄一层后处理，去重就能修，用不着动主模型。
缓存让编码器结果复用，重算的是行为侧的轻量更新网络。
optionExplanations_en: The score does get sharper, but the polluted distribution is a separate issue.
Estimating quantiles per scoring event lets active content vote many times.
Calibration is a thin post-processing layer; dedupe fixes it without touching the main model.
Caching reuses encoder outputs; what reruns is the lightweight behavioral update network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型原始分数映射成可比概率的后处理层，用来保证自动删除达到 95% precision。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A calibration layer maps raw model scores into comparable probabilities so the auto-delete path can hit its 95% precision target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在举报、曝光激增等事件发生后对同一条内容重新打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Re-triggering means scoring the same piece of content again after events like a report or a view spike.

scenario: 面试官问 harmful content 系统的目标是什么，你直接回答「最小化 binary cross-entropy」。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what the harmful-content system optimizes and you answer "minimize binary cross-entropy".
q: 业务目标和 ML objective / loss function 的本质区别是什么？
q_en: What is the essential difference between a business objective and an ML objective or loss function?
options: 两者是同一件事的不同叫法，写出 loss 就等于写清了业务目标
业务目标是业务在乎的终点，loss 只是逼近它的可优化代理
业务目标只在上线之后才存在，设计阶段确定 loss 就够了
业务目标必须是可微函数，loss 反而可以是任意不可微的业务指标，两者的角色刚好互换
options_en: They are two names for one thing; writing the loss already states the business objective.
The business objective is the end the business cares about; the loss is only an optimizable proxy for it.
A business objective exists only after launch, so at design time picking the loss is enough.
The business objective has to be differentiable while the loss can be any non-differentiable business metric, exactly swapping their usual roles.
why: 「少一次有害曝光」是业务在乎的终点，view-weighted BCE 只是能被梯度下降优化的代理；先定终点，才知道该拿哪个 loss 去逼近它。
why_en: Fewer views of harmful content is the end the business cares about; view-weighted cross-entropy is just a proxy gradient descent can optimize. Pick the end first, then the loss that approximates it.
optionExplanations: 混为一谈就会优化了指标却没改善用户体验。
代理和终点分开，才有空间讨论代理好不好。
目标恰恰要在设计最前面定，它决定后面所有取舍。
可微的是 loss，业务目标反而常常不可微。
optionExplanations_en: Conflating them leads to improving a metric without improving user experience.
Separating proxy from end leaves room to ask whether the proxy is any good.
The objective must be set first; it decides every tradeoff downstream.
The loss is the differentiable one; business objectives often are not.

termDefinitions.meaning: 二分类交叉熵损失，衡量预测概率与 0/1 标签的差距。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binary cross-entropy measures the gap between a predicted probability and a zero-or-one label.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型层面要优化的形式化目标，比如二分类判断内容是否有害。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The ML objective is the formalized target the model optimizes, such as binary classification of harmful versus benign.

scenario: 候选业务目标是「在 95% precision 前提下最大化删除的有害内容条数」，比裸的最大化删除量已经好一截。
scenario_en: A candidate objective is "maximize the number of harmful posts removed, subject to 95% precision", already better than raw removal volume.
q: 这个带 precision guardrail 的删除量目标还剩下什么缺陷？
q_en: What flaw remains in this removal-volume objective even with a precision guardrail?
options: 它完全没有 precision-recall 权衡，删得越多分数越高
它按内容条数计分，0 曝光和百万曝光的有害帖等价
它必须靠专职审核团队标注，因此完全无法在线上度量
它会让模型倾向漏掉所有明显有害的内容，因为删除明显内容对这个指标毫无帮助
options_en: It carries no precision-recall tradeoff at all, so removing more always scores higher.
It counts posts, so a harmful post with zero views is worth the same as one with a million.
It depends on a dedicated moderation team for labels and therefore cannot be measured online.
It pushes the model to miss all obviously harmful content, because removing obvious cases does nothing for this metric.
why: guardrail 补上了 precision-recall 权衡，但计分单位仍然是「删了几条」而不是「少了几次有害曝光」，系统没有动力优先抓正在病毒式传播的那条。
why_en: The guardrail restores a precision-recall tradeoff, but the unit of account is still posts removed rather than harmful views avoided, so nothing pushes the system to catch the post going viral first.
optionExplanations: 权衡正是 guardrail 补进来的，这是上一版目标的毛病。
曝光量才是真实伤害，条数把它抹平了。
它同样能靠抽样标注在线上估计，标注难度不是分歧点。
明显有害的内容照样计入删除条数，没有反向激励。
optionExplanations_en: The guardrail is precisely what added that tradeoff; this was the previous objective flaw.
Views are where the real harm is, and a post count flattens that away.
It can also be estimated online via sampled labeling; labeling cost is not the disagreement.
Obviously harmful posts still count toward removals, so there is no reverse incentive.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在业务目标之外设的硬门槛，比如被自动删除的内容至少 95% 确实有害。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A precision guardrail is a hard floor beside the objective, such as requiring at least 95% of auto-removed content to be genuinely harmful.

scenario: 有人提议把分类从发帖同步路径挪到每天跑一次的离线批处理，能省一大笔 GPU 钱。
scenario_en: Someone proposes moving classification off the post-creation path into a once-a-day offline batch job to save a large GPU bill.
q: 用「最小化有害曝光量」这个目标，怎么判断分类能不能延后？
q_en: With "minimize views of harmful content" as the objective, how do you decide whether classification can be deferred?
options: 等待期间累积的有害曝光直接计入目标，延后多久等于亏多少
目标里没有时间维度，延后与否只能靠面试官拍板
只要 precision 仍然满足 95%，延后到第二天对目标没有任何影响
延后能让行为特征攒得更丰富、分类更准，所以按这个目标应当尽量等到曝光稳定之后再判
options_en: Views accumulated during the wait count straight into the objective, so delay carries a price tag.
The objective has no time dimension, so deferring is purely a call for the interviewer to make.
As long as precision still hits ninety-five percent, waiting until the next day costs the objective nothing.
Waiting lets behavioral features accumulate and makes classification sharper, so under this objective you should hold off until views stabilize.
why: 目标以曝光计价，延迟窗口里的每一次曝光都是成本，「能不能等」于是变成一笔可算的账；代价是早期没有行为特征、判准更低，要靠重触发补判。
why_en: The objective is priced in views, so every view inside the delay window is a cost and "can we wait" becomes arithmetic. The catch: early scoring has no behavioral features, so re-triggering must fill the gap.
optionExplanations: 把延迟折算成曝光，争论就变成算术。
抬高抽象层正是为了摆脱这种拍脑袋。
第二天再删，中间一天的曝光伤害已经发生了。
这在准确率视角下成立，但它把伤害算在了目标之外。
optionExplanations_en: Converting delay into views turns the argument into arithmetic.
Raising the abstraction level exists precisely to avoid such gut calls.
Deleting a day later still leaves a full day of exposure damage done.
True from an accuracy view, but it leaves the harm outside the objective.

termDefinitions.meaning: 有害内容被用户看到的次数，是这套系统真正要压低的伤害量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Harmful views count how many times users actually saw harmful content, the quantity this system is trying to drive down.

scenario: 主模型定为多模态 Transformer，面试只剩 20 分钟，特征讨论正在往越来越细的方向发散。
scenario_en: The main model is a multimodal transformer, only twenty minutes of the interview remain, and the feature discussion is drifting into ever finer detail.
q: hashtag、话题这类细粒度内容属性该不该单独建特征？
q_en: Should fine-grained content attributes like hashtags and topics be modeled as separate features?
options: 不单独建，把 hashtag 拼进文本输入，让强模型隐式学出来
每个 hashtag 建一个独立的 one-hot 特征列，让模型显式区分
先离线聚类出话题 ID，再把话题 ID 当类别特征喂进模型
把 hashtag 整个从输入里剔除，因为它们是用户自填的、噪声太大不值得信任
options_en: Do not model them separately: concatenate hashtags into the text input and let a strong model learn them implicitly.
Give every hashtag its own one-hot feature column so the model can tell them apart explicitly.
Cluster topics offline first, then feed the topic id in as a categorical feature.
Strip hashtags out of the input entirely, since they are user-authored and far too noisy to be trustworthy.
why: 内容侧只保留两路输入：拼接后的文本和图片集合；注意力自己能学出 hashtag 与话题的作用，手工拆细只会烧掉面试时间和特征管线的维护成本。
why_en: Keep just two content inputs, concatenated text and the image set. A transformer learns what hashtags and topics mean on its own, so hand-crafting them mostly burns interview time and pipeline maintenance.
tradeoff: 手工特征工程 vs 让模型隐式学习
whenOtherWins: 如果主模型换成逻辑回归这类学不出特征交互的浅模型，话题和 hashtag 就必须显式建成特征，否则模型完全看不到这层信息。
optionExplanations: 两路输入足够，剩下的交给注意力。
hashtag 长尾极长，one-hot 会炸出巨量稀疏列。
离线聚类多一条要维护的管线，还会滞后于新话题。
hashtag 是文本的一部分，剔除等于主动扔掉信号。
optionExplanations_en: Two inputs suffice; attention handles the rest.
The hashtag tail is enormous and one-hot explodes into huge sparse columns.
Offline clustering adds a pipeline to maintain and lags behind new topics.
Hashtags are part of the text; removing them throws away signal on purpose.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把类别值编码成只有一位为 1 的稀疏向量，类别一多维度就爆炸。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: One-hot encoding turns a categorical value into a sparse vector with a single one, which explodes in width when categories are many.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时接收文本、图片和表格特征、用注意力在模态之间交互的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A multimodal transformer ingests text, images and tabular features together and lets attention mix across modalities.

scenario: 你用「负面反应总数」当特征，模型上线后把所有刚发布几秒钟的帖子都判成 benign。
scenario_en: You used raw negative-reaction counts as a feature, and after launch the model calls every seconds-old post benign.
q: 行为特征为什么必须按帖龄矫正？
q_en: Why must behavioral features be corrected for the age of the post?
options: T=0 时所有帖子的负面行为计数都是 0，模型会把「新」误当成「无害」
帖龄本身就是最强的 harmful 信号，不矫正会白白浪费掉它
老帖子的计数会溢出整数范围，必须除以时间来防止数值爆炸
负面反应总数在不同时区的用户之间不可比，按帖龄归一化正是为了对齐时区差异
options_en: At time zero every post has a zero negative count, so the model reads "new" as "harmless".
Post age is itself the strongest harmful signal and leaving it uncorrected wastes it.
Counts on old posts overflow the integer range, so dividing by time prevents numeric blowup.
Raw negative counts are incomparable across users in different time zones, and age normalization is what aligns those zone differences.
why: 计数随曝光单调增长，新帖天然为 0，那代表还没人看到而不是无害；改用 negative_reactions_per_view 这类比例天然除掉帖龄，但低曝光时仍要平滑。
why_en: Counts only grow with exposure, so a new post sits at zero because nobody has seen it yet, not because it is safe. Ratios per view divide age out, but tiny denominators still need smoothing.
optionExplanations: 零计数和无害是两件事，模型分不清就学错。
帖龄是要被除掉的混杂量，不是目标信号。
溢出是工程细节，跟这里的偏差无关。
时区影响的是曝光节奏，不是帖龄矫正要解决的问题。
optionExplanations_en: A zero count and harmlessness are different things, and the model conflates them.
Post age is a confounder to divide out, not the signal you want.
Overflow is an engineering detail unrelated to this bias.
Time zones shift the pace of exposure, which is not what age correction fixes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负面反应数除以曝光数的比例特征，用分母天然抵消帖龄差异。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative reactions per view divides reactions by views, letting the denominator cancel out differences in post age.

scenario: 行为特征要等曝光积累才有值，但帖子刚发布的那一刻系统就必须先出一个分。
scenario_en: Behavioral features only have values once views accumulate, yet the system must produce a score the moment a post is created.
q: 「行为数据还没到也要能出分」这条要求怎么影响架构选型？
q_en: How does the requirement "must score before behavioral data arrives" shape the architecture choice?
options: 架构必须在部分模态和特征缺失时照常出分，多模态 Transformer 用注意力天然支持
必须等行为数据到齐再打分，这条要求不影响架构选型
缺失值一律填 0 就行，任何架构都能满足，不需要额外考虑
必须为「有行为特征」和「无行为特征」各训练一套完全独立的模型，上线时按帖龄路由到不同模型
options_en: The architecture must still score with modalities and features missing, which a multimodal transformer supports natively through attention.
You must wait until behavioral data is complete before scoring, so this does not constrain the architecture.
Just impute zeros for missing values; any architecture satisfies this without special thought.
You must train two fully separate models, one with behavioral features and one without, and route by post age at serving time.
why: 选型的第四条硬要求就是「新行为数据没到时也能出分」；多模态 Transformer 靠注意力天然处理缺失模态，还带 zero-shot 能力，代价是算力与复杂度最高。
why_en: The fourth selection requirement is scoring before new behavioral data lands. A multimodal transformer handles missing modalities natively via attention and is strong zero-shot, at the highest compute cost.
tradeoff: 缺失输入的容忍度 vs 算力与实现复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果分类可以统一延后到行为数据齐备后再批量跑，就不必为缺失输入付架构代价，late fusion 拼接固定长度特征更省算力。
optionExplanations: 缺失容忍度直接淘汰掉一批要求全特征齐备的架构。
等数据齐备就等于放任延迟窗口内的曝光伤害。
填 0 会和「真的零负面反应」撞在一起，语义被抹平。
两套模型意味着两份训练、两份监控、两条上线流水线。
optionExplanations_en: Tolerance for missing inputs rules out architectures that demand a complete feature vector.
Waiting for complete data means accepting exposure damage inside the delay window.
Zero imputation collides with genuinely zero reactions and flattens the distinction.
Two models mean two trainings, two monitoring stacks and two release pipelines.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型在没见过该任务的标注样本时也能直接给出预测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-shot means the model can predict on a task without having seen labeled examples of it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只给极少量样例，模型就能适应一个新任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Few-shot means the model adapts to a new task from only a handful of examples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 文本和图片各自编码后再把向量拼接起来送进一个小分类网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Late fusion encodes text and images separately, then concatenates the embeddings into a small classification network.

scenario: 有人提议文本模型和图片模型各出一个 harmful 分数、取 max 作为最终分，但你还要塞进行为特征和作者 embedding。
scenario_en: Someone proposes scoring text and images with separate models and taking the max, but you still need to fold in behavioral features and creator embeddings.
q: 除了抓不到跨模态交互，这个 max-pooling 方案还有什么代价？
q_en: Beyond missing cross-modal interactions, what else does this max-pooling design cost?
options: 行为和作者特征无处安放，且每条内容都要跑两个模型
两个模型的输出分数一定不可比，max 操作在数学上无法定义
它无法使用任何预训练模型，只能从零训练文本和图片编码器
它的推理延迟一定高于多模态 Transformer，因为两个小模型必须严格串行执行
options_en: Behavioral and creator features have nowhere to live, and every post has to run through two models.
The two model scores are necessarily incomparable, so the max operation is mathematically undefined.
It cannot reuse any pretrained model and must train the text and image encoders from scratch.
Its inference latency is necessarily higher than a multimodal transformer because the two small models must run strictly in sequence.
why: max 只合并两个标量分数，行为和作者特征没有插入点，要么再补一层要么放弃这些交互；同时每条内容固定两次前向，1B 帖每天下算力直接翻倍。
why_en: A max merges two scalars, so behavioral and creator features have no insertion point, and every post pays two forward passes, doubling compute at a billion posts a day.
optionExplanations: 标量出口挡住了一切非内容特征。
经过校准的概率是可比的，这不是它的问题。
恰恰相反，能直接复用预训练模型是它的卖点。
两个小模型可以并行，延迟不必然更差。
optionExplanations_en: A scalar output blocks every non-content feature from entering.
Calibrated probabilities are comparable, so this is not the flaw.
On the contrary, reusing pretrained models directly is its selling point.
The two small models can run in parallel, so latency is not necessarily worse.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在多个模型的输出分数中取最大值作为最终判断。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Max-pooling here takes the largest of several model output scores as the final verdict.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次把输入送过模型算出输出的推理过程，是算力消耗的计价单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A forward pass is one run of input through the model to produce output, and it is the unit compute is billed in.

scenario: 两段式 serving：轻量 student 模型给全部 1B 帖打分，超过通过阈值的才送重模型；GPU 预算突然被砍三成。
scenario_en: Two-stage serving: a distilled student model scores all one billion posts and only those above a pass threshold reach the heavy model. The GPU budget is suddenly cut by a third.
q: 调这个级联通过阈值会同时改变什么？
q_en: What does turning the cascade pass threshold change at the same time?
options: 阈值调高，送进重模型的量下降，算力省下来但漏检变多
阈值只影响轻模型自身的准确率，重模型的调用量不变
阈值调高会让重模型收到更多内容，因为更多帖子被判成可疑
阈值是训练期确定的超参，上线之后无法在不重训 student 模型的前提下调整
options_en: Raise the threshold, fewer posts reach the heavy model: you save compute but miss more harmful content.
The threshold only affects the light model own accuracy; the heavy model call volume is unchanged.
Raising the threshold sends more content to the heavy model because more posts get marked suspicious.
The threshold is a training-time hyperparameter and cannot be adjusted after launch without retraining the student model.
why: 通过阈值是上线后随时能拨的旋钮，往上拨直接减少重模型调用量、按比例省 GPU；代价是被轻模型判成无害的内容再也不会被重模型看到，recall 下降。
why_en: The pass threshold is a knob you can turn live: raise it and heavy-model calls drop proportionally with GPU spend, at the cost that anything the light model clears is never seen again, so recall falls.
optionExplanations: 一个数字同时定住成本和漏检率。
重模型的调用量恰恰由这个阈值决定。
方向反了，阈值越高通过的越少。
它是推理期的判定阈值，改配置即可生效。
optionExplanations_en: One number pins down both cost and miss rate at once.
The heavy model call volume is exactly what this threshold sets.
Backwards: a higher threshold lets fewer posts through.
It is a serving-time decision threshold, changeable by config.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过蒸馏学习重模型输出的小模型，用更少特征换更低推理成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A student model is distilled to mimic the heavy teacher model, trading fewer features for much lower inference cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先用便宜模型筛掉明显无害的内容，只把剩下的交给昂贵模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cascade screens obvious non-violations with a cheap model and forwards only the remainder to the expensive one.

scenario: 候选模型离线 PR-AUC 涨了 3 个点，上线 AB 之后有害曝光量一动没动。
scenario_en: A candidate model gains three points of offline PR-AUC, yet after the online A/B test harmful views do not move at all.
q: 这说明评估体系的哪条要求没被满足？
q_en: Which requirement of the evaluation framework does this failure expose?
options: 离线指标必须对线上业务结果有预测力，否则离线涨点没有意义
线上实验应该整个取消，只信任离线测试集上的指标
离线测试集样本量不够，只要扩到千万级就能自动对齐线上结果
PR-AUC 本身就是错误的指标，任何情况下都应该改用整体 accuracy 来评估这类模型
options_en: Offline metrics must be predictive of online business results, otherwise an offline gain means nothing.
Online experiments should be dropped entirely in favor of trusting the offline test set.
The offline test set is simply too small; scaling it to tens of millions would align it with online results.
PR-AUC is the wrong metric outright and models like this should always be evaluated with overall accuracy instead.
why: 评估有两条并列要求：线上要证明有害曝光真的降了，离线指标要能预测线上；离线涨而线上不动，说明测试集分布与真实曝光分布脱节。
why_en: Evaluation has two demands: online must show harmful views actually fell, and offline metrics must predict that. A gain that does not transfer means the test set is detached from real exposure.
optionExplanations: 预测力是离线评估存在的全部理由，改用 impression-weighted 指标可对齐。
取消线上实验就没人能证明业务目标改善了。
样本量修方差，修不了分布错位。
PR-AUC 稳定且适合稀有正类，问题在权重不在指标。
optionExplanations_en: Predictive power is why offline evaluation exists; impression-weighted metrics realign it.
Dropping online tests leaves nobody able to prove the business objective improved.
Sample size fixes variance, not a mismatched distribution.
PR-AUC is stable and suits a rare positive class; the issue is weighting, not the metric.

termDefinitions.meaning: 精确率-召回率曲线下的面积，在正类稀有时比 ROC-AUC 更能反映判别力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PR-AUC is the area under the precision-recall curve, a better discriminative signal than ROC-AUC when positives are rare.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按曝光次数给样本加权计算指标，让离线数字对齐真正的曝光伤害。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Impression-weighted metrics weight each sample by its views so offline numbers line up with real exposure harm.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把流量分给候选模型和对照模型并行运行，比较业务指标差异。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An A/B test splits traffic between a candidate and a control model and compares their business metrics.

scenario: 作者 embedding 用 GCN 训练，新注册用户没有向量只能插补全体平均，而插补质量会随时间累积变差。
scenario_en: Creator embeddings are trained with a GCN, so brand-new users have no vector and fall back to an averaged one whose quality degrades over time.
q: 在下一次全图重训之前，怎么压住新用户带来的风险？
q_en: Before the next full retrain, how do you contain the risk new users bring?
options: 给没有 embedding 的新用户加发帖限制，压低他们造成有害曝光的上限
对新用户直接用最保守的删除阈值，一律先删后申诉
给新用户随机分配一个已有用户的 embedding，保证输入维度完整
把新用户的样本从训练集里全部剔除，让模型不再依赖 embedding 这一路输入
options_en: Apply posting limits to new users who have no embedding, capping the harmful exposure they can cause.
Use the most aggressive removal threshold on new users and let them appeal afterwards.
Assign each new user a random existing user embedding so the input vector stays complete.
Drop all new-user samples from the training set so the model stops relying on the embedding input entirely.
why: 重训周期内新用户永远缺 embedding，插补平均只会稀释信号；限制他们的发帖与触达上限，等于把风险敞口按曝光量封顶，代价是新用户体验变差。
why_en: New users lack an embedding for the whole retrain cycle and averaging only dilutes the signal, so capping their posting and reach bounds the exposure risk, at the cost of a worse new-user experience.
tradeoff: 新用户体验与增长 vs 无 embedding 期间的风险敞口
whenOtherWins: 如果能负担 GraphSAGE 这类 inductive 模型的推理成本和缓存基建，就直接为新用户实时生成 embedding，不必再靠限流兜底。
optionExplanations: 限制触达把风险按曝光封顶，正好对齐业务目标的计价单位。
一刀切先删会大量误伤，直接违背 95% precision 的硬门槛。
随机向量是把噪声当特征，比平均值更糟。
砍掉这路输入等于放弃作者信号，代价远大于新用户风险。
optionExplanations_en: Capping reach bounds risk in views, exactly the unit the business objective is priced in.
Blanket removal creates mass false positives and breaks the ninety-five percent precision floor.
A random vector feeds noise in as signal, which is worse than averaging.
Cutting the input drops the creator signal entirely, costing far more than new-user risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 图卷积网络，在社交图上为已有节点学习向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A graph convolutional network learns vector representations for nodes that exist in the training graph.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用平均值或先验填补缺失特征，代价是稀释真实信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Imputation fills a missing feature with an average or prior value, at the cost of diluting the real signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型学的是从邻居关系生成向量的函数，因此能覆盖训练时不存在的新节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inductive model learns a function that generates a vector from a node neighborhood, so it covers nodes unseen at training time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种归纳式图神经网络，用邻居子图为新节点现场生成 embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GraphSAGE is an inductive graph neural network that generates embeddings for new nodes from their neighbor subgraph.

scenario: 团队决定改用 GraphSAGE 为新用户实时生成 embedding，而社交图有十亿量级节点。
scenario_en: The team switches to GraphSAGE to generate embeddings for new users on the fly, on a social graph with billions of nodes.
q: 选 GraphSAGE 要付出哪些代价？
q_en: What does choosing GraphSAGE cost?
options: 模型更大、推理成本更高，还要建缓存和取子图的基建
它无法为新用户生成 embedding，冷启动问题依然存在
它只能离线批量训练，因此完全无法用于实时打分场景
它需要把整张社交图常驻内存，否则每一次推理都要把全图重新训练一遍
options_en: A bigger model, higher inference cost, plus new caching and subgraph-fetching infrastructure.
It still cannot generate embeddings for new users, so the cold-start problem remains.
It can only be trained offline in batches and therefore cannot serve real-time scoring at all.
It needs the entire social graph resident in memory, otherwise every single inference retrains the whole graph from scratch.
why: inductive 是拿计算换覆盖：每次要取用户子图跑一次模型，必须激进缓存 embedding 并新建取数基建；换来的是新用户当天就有向量，且能复用给其他业务。
why_en: Inductive trades compute for coverage: each call fetches a subgraph and runs the model, forcing aggressive embedding caches and new fetch infrastructure, in exchange for same-day vectors reusable elsewhere.
optionExplanations: 成本落在推理算力和一套新的子图取数与缓存服务上。
能覆盖新用户正是选它的理由。
它同样支持在线推理，靠邻居子图现算向量。
取子图是局部操作，用不着全图常驻也不会重训。
optionExplanations_en: The cost lands on inference compute plus a new subgraph fetch and cache service.
Covering new users is precisely why it was chosen.
It supports online inference too, computing a vector from the neighbor subgraph.
Subgraph fetching is local; no whole-graph residency and no retraining involved.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种归纳式图神经网络，用节点的邻居子图现场生成 embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GraphSAGE is an inductive graph neural network that generates an embedding on the fly from a node neighbor subgraph.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从整张社交图里只取出目标用户及其邻居的一小块。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A subgraph is a small slice of the full social graph containing just the target user and their neighbors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新实体没有历史数据，模型拿不到它的表示或信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is when a new entity has no history, so the model has no representation or signal for it.
